claims.root_review_note: 区分追加可见与显式 flush；flush 汇集当前所有 writer 的异常，不能把全局异常反推每个目标都未存。
drain 失败恢复缓冲并暂停定时 drain；显式 drain 可恢复重试；flushAll 聚合多个 writer，目标成功与全局失败可以共存。
commit 写内存 log 不等待持久屏障；这里只确认可见与持久分离的切点，不验证当前运行后端。
标准 /api route 在进入 bridge 前调用 connection.admit 并拒绝未授权/不可信请求；不是插件 HTTP 文件独自提供全部身份边界。
admit 核 Host/Origin、browser/API 凭据和 live Peer；exact fetch route 仅允许 owner 后调用 route.fetch(request)。owner 为宿主实例级主体，callback 只收 Request；未验证实际宿主版本或所有carrier。

attribution.author: Model Context Protocol maintainers / ext-tasks contributors

coverage: L7-89 extension, server-directed creation, per-request capabilities and tools/call-only scope

claims: CreateTaskResult MUST NOT precede durable creation, operationally tasks/get resolves the returned taskId; eventual consistency must be waited out.
completed includes tools/call CallToolResult.isError=true; failed is JSON-RPC error, not tool-level error.
Successful tasks/cancel MUST acknowledge with an empty result; resultType is complete. Cooperative cancellation does not guarantee stopping or eventual cancelled.
Clients MAY discard task state when sending cancel; this permission does not assert external effects are resolved.
Per-request capability required, only tools/call supported currently. Each task request MUST authenticate/authorize; task IDs MAY be bearer capabilities.

limits: Published versioned official extension, not core; no claim all deployed hosts or SDKs implement it.
Durable creation wording does not define every power-loss/storage failure profile.
No external business acceptance, target-side effect ledger or proof of termination is specified by these read sections.

coverage: L70-157 request scoped streams and no Last-Event-ID resumption

claims: 2026-07-28 removes protocol sessions and GET stream endpoint; requests use separate POSTs.
SSE resumption through Last-Event-ID is not supported.
Closing SSE response stream MUST be treated as cancellation of that request; server SHOULD stop as practical and MUST NOT send further messages for it.
Legacy protocol sessions and resumable SSE are distinct revision behaviors.

limits: Stream cancellation scope is a request, not proof of external rollback or a tasks/cancel substitute.
This source does not supply the claimed universal MUST to retry with a fresh request ID. That phrasing was seen in Go SDK documentation and is deliberately not treated as core normative text.
No claim retrying a tools/call is safe without an operation-specific effect contract.

coverage: Entire 123-line page; especially L34-43 transport scope and L65-84 behavior

claims: stdio client MUST use notifications/cancelled for in-flight request cancellation; HTTP disconnect signals cancellation.
Servers SHOULD stop and free resources but MAY ignore when unknown, finished or noncancellable; clients SHOULD ignore late responses.
Task cancellation is separately defined in S01, not this ordinary request notification path.

limits: Ignoring a late response is not an effect-resolution fact.
SHOULD resource release is not MUST physical termination.

coverage: L260-297 per-request token and audience handling

claims: HTTP authorization support is optional; supported HTTP implementations SHOULD conform, stdio SHOULD use environment credentials instead of this flow.
Authorization MUST accompany every HTTP request in this authorization flow.
Tokens must be valid for the intended server/resource; servers MUST NOT accept or transit other tokens.

limits: Read selected authorization requirements, not a full OAuth security audit.
Transport/resource authorization does not by itself encode a human approval bound to an exact action/parameters/version/deadline.

attribution.author: A2A Protocol Working Group / a2aproject contributors

coverage: §5.3 L1169 and REST operation listing L2795

claims: CancelTask attempts cancellation and returns an updated Task; success is not guaranteed. Repeated cancel operation is idempotent, not a compensation guarantee.
SubscribeToTask MUST first emit current Task and stream terminates at terminal state. Terminal tasks cannot be subscribed to.
Messages/history can omit entries; reconnect can lose status messages; messages MUST NOT serve as reliable critical-information delivery.
Send Message MAY be idempotent and may deduplicate by messageId; universal dedup is not guaranteed.
Wire protocol version is Major.Minor 1.0; empty defaults to 0.3, not automatic latest.
AUTH_REQUIRED can carry a request for downstream credentials or human approval; out-of-band flow can resume without a follow-up message.
Send Message may return a direct Message without a Task; no task handle is implied.

limits: Pinned published v1.0.1, not current moving main (which has later commits).
Current snapshot on subscribe is not complete event replay or total-order history.
Agent-specific authorization semantics and business acceptance remain application-defined.

Published v1.0.1 has unresolved text/source discrepancies: spec L1169/L2795 POST subscribe vs proto L78 GET; spec L180 immediate return vs L444-448 configurable default blocking. This review does not choose an SDK as authority to resolve them.

attribution.author: A2A Protocol Working Group / a2aproject contributors

coverage: L64-86 CancelTask and SubscribeToTask service signatures
L221-321 Part, Role, Message, Artifact, artifact update

claims: COMPLETED claims task finished successfully; FAILED error; CANCELED before completion; AUTH_REQUIRED is interrupted.
ROLE_USER means client-to-server role; it does not identify a human author.
Task/context/message/artifact IDs have distinct ownership/scope; artifactId unique within a task.
Artifact updates have append and last_chunk flags; Part may hold text, bytes, URL or data.

limits: Proto required fields are not external effect proof, durable delivery proof, content digest or business reviewer signature.
No claim a final artifact chunk contains all earlier chunks after disconnection.

coverage: Entire 55-line source; L5-14 accepted, L39-46 deliver, L48-54 user/stop

claims: Native.deliver preserves source.kind=agent-message despite role=user.
Matching event/live inbox ID causes return before sessionPersistence.flush; new enqueue awaits flush.
Native.stop calls agent.cancel and supplies no external-effect termination evidence.

limits: This is an actual DSH adapter, not an implemented MCP/A2A bridge.
Source inspection and previously completed controlled-fake probes are distinct from real-host runtime acceptance.
Historical/local message presence is not a general durable task creation acknowledgment or business acceptance.

claims: Worker report can set review, waiting_user or failed, not completed.
accept requires review and Native.running=false then stores completed; this is a local action gate, not independently verified external business correctness.
retry increments generation; stop changes local state before Native.stop.

limits: Do not attribute a signed human approval or artifact-version-bound acceptance to this handler alone.
No protocol-interoperability code is present in this examined slice.

claims: The 2025-11-25 page labels Tasks experimental; requestors could be clients or servers and task augmentation was requestor-directed.
